findings.trigger: Native binary exists without execute permission; run launcher then recommended repair
findings.violated_expectation: Repair must either restore usable installation or report failure
findings.consequence: Repair exits zero but launcher still fails
findings.disposition_reason: Parent traced launcher -x rejection and both downloader -f skip branches; reviewer reproduced false success

observations.claim: Recommended repair falsely succeeds for non-executable binary

findings.fix_evidence: retain_binary restores and checks execute permission; exact printed-repair regression and independent chmod-failure probe pass

findings.trigger: Owner omits release marker from tracked scripts; fresh worktree contains scripts without marker
findings.violated_expectation: Repair must not silently unpin installation dependencies
findings.consequence: Pinned skill scripts are paired with an unspecified latest release executable
findings.evidence: REVIEW_SOL.md SOL-01-F2 actual worktree and controlled URL reproduction
findings.disposition_reason: Parent confirmed missing marker selects latest default; reviewer exercised actual worktree

observations.claim: Missing release metadata silently unpins worktree repair

findings.fix_evidence: Missing/empty pin requires explicit remote release before writes/network; actual markerless-worktree and override precedence probes pass

findings.trigger: Read stale pending-approval sentence after explicit approval
findings.violated_expectation: Plan must consistently record active approval
findings.disposition_reason: Parent read contradictory sentence and replaced it with subsequent approval reference

observations.claim: Clarification paragraph conflicts with current approval section

findings.fix_evidence: Plan clarification now explicitly refers to subsequent user approval
